asked.item: Where is the green Fix My Automation button for a Make.com scenario
Is the button hidden on my plan

verdict.reason: The pages say Fix My Automation is n8n only and does not work for Make.com, and they point to the manual checklist instead.

steps.text: The FIX MY AUTOMATION button is n8n only, and it does not work for Make.com.
For Make.com, use the manual troubleshooting checklist. It starts with checking your Blotato API key, Account IDs, and Page/channel IDs.
You can also open the Logs and click a request to see the full payload, error response, and which account it was sent to.
